exam_name: CPSM Exam 1 — Foundation of Supply Management

testing_centers.notes: Computer-based testing at Prometric test centers worldwide. Online proctoring available for select windows.

id_requirements: One government-issued photo ID with full name and signature. Name must match ISM registration exactly.
exam_rules: Closed-book. Open-book NOT permitted. No notes or reference materials. All three CPSM exams must be passed within a 3-year window to earn the CPSM designation.
renewal_options: Earn 60 continuing education hours (CEHs) every 3 years and pay the recertification fee. CEHs can be earned through ISM-approved courses, conferences, seminars, teaching, and publications.

prerequisites.description: Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution
3 years of supply management experience in a professional-level position

retake_policy.notes: 30-day waiting period between attempts. Full exam fee required for retake.

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the ISM CPSM Exam 1 covering contracting, finance, international supply management, leadership, and supplier relationships with verified study.
editorial.overview: CPSM Exam 1 — Foundation of Supply Management is an official certification examination administered by ISM to evaluate professional procurement and supply management practitioners across five distinct domains. These key areas include contracting, financial management, international supply operations, strategic leadership, and effective supplier relationship management methodologies required for modern industry professionals.
editorial.who_should_take: Supply management professionals with extensive procurement experience who wish to demonstrate their advanced expertise across manufacturing, service, and public sector organizations globally today, ensuring strong career advancement potential.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Carefully review the official exam guide completely and successfully complete multiple practice tests to identify any weaker content areas scoring below target levels. Build a focused study plan utilizing approved learning systems and diverse reference materials to ensure complete understanding of all tested domains.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses primarily on supplier contracting, sourcing plans, category management, the preparation and execution of complex negotiations, legal compliance requirements, and primary contract administration procedures for supply professionals.

This domain carefully covers cost management program strategies, detailed cost-benefit analyses, extensive spend analysis, and accurate tracking mechanisms for both cost savings and cost avoidance across the entire organization.

This domain addresses global supply management concepts, international sourcing requirements, cross-border logistics, and the specific regulatory challenges associated with successfully operating supply chains across international borders and regions.

This domain involves strategic planning initiatives, leadership principles, departmental budgeting techniques, and aligning all internal supply management operational activities closely with overarching organizational objectives and long-term business goals.

This domain centers entirely on developing effective supplier relationships, creating appropriate supplier qualification plans, conducting performance evaluations, holding formal business reviews, and successfully rationalizing the broader supply base.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive at the designated test center early with required identification matching your registration name. Manage your 180 minutes carefully across all available test questions to achieve success.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The certification exam contains a total of 165 multiple-choice questions administered via a linear computer-based testing format at authorized testing centers for all registered candidates.
Candidates taking this certification test must achieve a minimum passing score of 70 to successfully demonstrate competency and pass the examination according to established guidelines.
Candidates are given a total duration of 180 minutes to complete the linear computer-based test within the allocated testing window provided by the official administration.

faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?
faq.answer_text: The standard exam price is $595 for active ISM members and $765 for non-members registering for the professional certification program through the official channels provided by the organization.

methodology.summary: This informative page was created using official ISM candidate handbooks, certification documentation, and verified exam data to assist professionals preparing for their credentials.
